mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1400 units, indicating robust demand, boosts consumer confidence, leading to increased spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between HOUST and consumer confidence
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST surpasses 1400 units.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 3.5% signals accommodative monetary policy, reducing borrowing costs and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) drops below 4.0%, signaling a tight labor market, and payroll employment (PAYEMS) grows by more than 200,000 in a month, the combined effect predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns over 60d are not significantly higher (t-test p > 0.05) when both conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% in a quarter, indicating strong supply-side growth, leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward IC of INDPRO with SPX returns is below 0.01 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Real disposable personal income (RSAFS) growth exceeding 5% YoY, coupled with a CPI (CPIAUCSL) below 2.5%, predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to increased consumer spending power.
failure_condition: SPX returns are not significantly higher (t-test p > 0.05) when both conditions are met.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 50 basis points in a quarter, signaling aggressive monetary easing, leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC of FEDFUNDS with SPX returns is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on signal: the labor market's influence on consumer spending makes payroll employment (PAYEMS) a persistent predictor of positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward IC of PAYEMS with SPX returns is below 0.01 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: GDP (GDPC1) growth above 3% YoY, indicating strong aggregate demand, predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, but only during mid-cycle growth regimes.
failure_condition: SPX returns over 60d are not significantly higher (t-test p > 0.05) during mid-cycle growth when GDPC1 growth exceeds 3% YoY.
